issues: Party name 'PT BORNEO INDAH MARJAYA' is promoted to h4.doc-heading 4 times by the ALL-CAPS heading heuristic (isHeadingLine). It is a party name, not a section title. Consider blacklisting common corp prefixes (PT, CV, PERSEROAN, PERSEKUTUAN) from heading promotion, or require stronger section-title keywords.

The 'Alamat : …' doc-field line was merged with a trailing continuation 'Pengadilan Pajak tersebut,' because the previous field line ends with a comma — field-continuation glue (continuesField) can over-reach when PDF line breaks happen to leave a comma; consider also requiring the next line to start lowercase before gluing fields.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Refine isHeadingLine heuristic to avoid promoting ALL-CAPS party names (e.g., skip lines starting with 'PT ', 'CV ', 'PERSEROAN', etc.) so they stay as regular paragraphs.
(Optional, minor) Tighten the field-continuation rule in groupBodyLines so a trailing comma alone doesn't absorb an unrelated follow-up fragment.
critical_code_review_comments: _make_summary (server.py ~L284) correctly truncates at '. ' / '; ' when available (threshold 160) and otherwise cuts at word boundary + ellipsis, strips table markers and spaced-caps — matches cleanLede on the frontend; both paths validated.
renderReflowedText emits span.doc-line with id='paragraph-Pn' and data-testid='document-paragraph-Pn'; counter aligns 1:1 with non-empty lines in body, preserving citation navigation.
No console errors across detail/compare/peraturan flows.
